gaps.summary: Production PostgreSQL/vector MemoryStore, indexes, migrations, backup, and restore are not part of the Git workspace reference adapter.
V1 forget appends a tombstone; legal hard-delete, retention enforcement, and audited purge orchestration require a separate governance path.
V1 ranking is deterministic lexical/metadata based; production embedding generation, vector search, and semantic reranking remain adapters.
Hosted NODE-35 CI must not be called PASS unless a real runner executes checkout and test steps; runner_id=0 with steps=[] is BLOCKED_EXTERNAL.
